d:
All Bells in Paradise is a new carol written by John Rutter for the Choir of King's College, Cambridge. It is the final track on their new album, Nine Lessons & Carols, and will be included in the Festival of Nine Lessons & Carols, broadcast live on Christmas Eve, 2012.
Nine Lessons & Carols is the first release from the Choir of King's College, Cambridge on their own label, available now from all good record shops.
